description: DJConnect spoken music intent examples for the post-STT PTT pipeline.
rules: Explicit media words win over generic phrasing.
Requests with album/plaat are album intents, even when the sentence also contains van/by.
Requests with nummer/liedje/track/song are track intents.
Generic requests such as Speel Nirvana remain artist-first.
Current-track questions read Spotify playback status and generate a DJ response without starting playback.
Direct playback-control phrases bypass Spotify search and Assist intent parsing.
Local deterministic parsing can override stale or generic HA Assist results.
HA may use Assist STT correction before intent parsing, but Spotify credentials are never sent to Assist.
ask_dj_rules: Ask DJ text and app voice/PTT requests are conversational and can answer without changing playback.
Informational Ask DJ requests keep action none unless the user clearly asks for playback.
Playback/hybrid Ask DJ requests may execute Spotify/Home Assistant actions and return a DJ response.
Short acknowledgements such as Geeft niet, Dank je and Laat maar are conversational follow-ups, not new lookups.
Help, speaker/output and recent listening-history requests are read-only unless the backend explicitly returns playback_actions.
Ambient Ask DJ facts can appear without a user request when Spotify artist/album context changes; these use message_kind system.

current_track.description: Ask which track is currently active. DJConnect reads Spotify playback state and returns a DJ response. If nothing is playing or Spotify is unavailable, it still returns a friendly answer.

playback_control.description: Direct playback controls. These do not run Spotify search. They call the Spotify backend command and then generate a DJ response.

nl: Ik heb wel zin in Nirvana
Zet het liedje Black van Pearl Jam op
Draai track Nothing Else Matters van Metallica
Speel artiest Nirvana met nummer Lithium
Speel de monsterhit In And Out Of Love van Armin van Buuren
Draai die dikke knaller Adagio For Strings van Tiësto
en: Play the track Black by Pearl Jam
Play artist Nirvana with song Lithium

nl: Speel album Ten van Pearl Jam
Zet de plaat OK Computer van Radiohead op
Draai album Rumours van Fleetwood Mac
en: Play the album Ten by Pearl Jam
Put on album OK Computer by Radiohead

conversation_followup.description: Short conversational replies are answered naturally without rerunning the previous lookup or mutating playback.

help.description: Ask what DJConnect can do. The response is a categorized text-only list of prompt options and must not reuse media cards or artwork.

personal_memory_summary.description: Ask what DJConnect currently remembers about the user. The response must be based on DJ Memory only, without live playback artwork, Spotify profile enrichment or Play Now actions.
nl: Wat weet je nu over mij?
Wat staat er in mijn DJ Memory?
Wat herinner je je over mij?
en: What do you know about me?
What does DJConnect know about me?
What is in my DJ Memory?
What do you remember about me?

speaker_outputs.description: Ask which Spotify output devices are available or request speaker switching. DJConnect returns a text list plus output actions when devices are known.
nl: Zet de muziek op de woonkamer speaker
en: Move music to the living room speaker

retry_previous_request.description: Retry the previous retryable playback request from server-side Ask DJ history or memory. Clients must not reconstruct the old request locally.

contextual_play_followup.description: Short playback follow-ups resolve against recent Ask DJ chat context. If the recent track has no artist context, Ask DJ asks which artist the user means instead of guessing.

album_discography.description: Ask for an artist's albums. DJConnect can return a chronological album list with proxied album covers and Play Now actions per album.
nl: Welke albums bracht deze artiest uit?
Welke albums zijn er van Prince?
Geef me de albums van Guns N' Roses
en: Which albums did this artist release?

similar_artists.description: Ask for artists with similar music, using an explicit artist, current playback artist or recent conversation artist.
nl: Welke artiesten maken vergelijkbare muziek als Radiohead?
Welke artiesten maken vergelijkbare muziek als wat nu speelt?
Welke artiesten lijken op deze artiest?
Vergelijkbare artiesten als de artiest waar het in de conversatie over gaat
en: Which artists make similar music to Radiohead?
Which artists are similar to what is playing now?

artist_genre_style.description: Ask what kind of music an artist makes. DJConnect phrases Spotify genre/profile data naturally.
nl: Wat voor muziek maakt Beastie Boys?
Wat voor muziek maakt deze artiest?
Wat is het genre van Radiohead?
en: What kind of music does Beastie Boys make?
What kind of music does this artist make?

concert_agenda.description: Ask for upcoming concerts. DJConnect can return date, location and clickable source links when web agenda data is available.
en: When does Radiohead play in the Netherlands?
Does this artist have upcoming concerts?

next_track_info.description: Ask what the next queued track is. DJConnect reads Spotify queue context and can return track, artist, album art and a Play Now action without skipping automatically.

personal_music_profile_analysis.description: Ask for a personal listening profile based on DJConnect Memory and Spotify recently played/top profile data.
nl: Omschrijf eens waar ik zoal naar luisterde de afgelopen maand
Wat zegt mijn muziek van de laatste twee weken over mijn stemming?
Welke genres luister ik de laatste tijd veel?
Maak een profiel van mijn muzieksmaak dit jaar
en: Describe what I have been listening to over the last month
What does my music from the last two weeks say about my mood?
Which genres have I been listening to lately?
Make a profile of my music taste this year

response_shape.playback_actions: none unless explicitly returned by backend

recently_played_history.description: Ask for recent listening-history lists for tracks, albums, artists or playlist contexts. DJConnect reads Spotify recently played data and returns read-only items with art/icon metadata.
nl: Welke nummers heb ik afgelopen uur afgespeeld?
Welke tracks heb ik net gehoord?
Welke albums heb ik vandaag geluisterd?
Welke playlists heb ik afgelopen uur gespeeld?
en: Which tracks did I play in the last hour?
Which songs did I just hear?
Which albums did I listen to today?
Which artists did I just hear?
Which playlists did I play in the last hour?
What did I listen to today?

personal_music_recommendations.description: Ask for recommendations. DJConnect can return Play Now actions but does not start playback until the user taps Play Now.
nl: Doe maar wat leuks van Radiohead
Zet een leuke playlist op met rustige muziek
Ik voel me moe en geprikkeld, zet iets ontspannends klaar
en: Give me something fun by Radiohead
Find a nice playlist with calm music
I feel tired and overstimulated, suggest something relaxing

seed_playlist_mix.description: Ask DJ to compose a playable mix from artist, track or genre seeds. The response returns a track_mix Play Now action and can later save the mix as a Spotify playlist.
nl: Stel een playlist samen op basis van Radiohead, Massive Attack en Portishead
Maak een mix met Above & Beyond, Armin van Buuren en Ferry Corsten
Ik wil een playlist obv tracks Reckoner, Teardrop en Angel
Ik wil een playlist in genre ambient, techno en downtempo
Sla deze mix op als Spotify playlist
en: Create a playlist based on Radiohead, Massive Attack and Portishead
Make a mix with Above & Beyond, Armin van Buuren and Ferry Corsten
I want a playlist based on tracks Reckoner, Teardrop and Angel
I want a playlist in genres ambient, techno and downtempo
Save this mix as a Spotify playlist

dj_announcement.description: Ask for a DJ-style announcement for the current or next track without changing playback.
nl: Geef me een leuke aankondiging voor wat nu speelt
Maak een DJ intro voor dit nummer
Vertel iets leuks over het volgende nummer
en: Give me a fun announcement for what is playing now
Make a DJ intro for this song
Tell me something fun about the next track

ambient_music_fact.description: Backend-generated text-only Ask DJ fact when Spotify playback moves to another artist/album combination. This has no user phrase and is included so website/client docs can explain the system bubble.
nl: Automatisch DJ feitje bij nieuw album of nieuwe artiest
en: Automatic DJ fact when a new album or artist starts

idle_suggestion.description: Backend-generated Ask DJ system message when the client opens Ask DJ while Spotify is idle. It can include one personalized Play Now action.
nl: Er speelt nu niets. Zin in iets nieuws?
en: Nothing is playing right now. Want something new?
